BiblicalUsage: Bildad opens his attack on Job with this word: make an end of words, stop talking, listen. It appears only once, and it is a rebuke, not a comfort.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bildad's hurry to end the words is the opposite of wisdom, because Job needed a friend who would stay, not one who cut him off.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
